## Cross-Chapter Anchor Links Test

::: {.content-hidden when-format="epub"}

Testing if anchor links from main content to specific parameter sections in the appendix work in PDF/HTML. (Excluded from EPUB: Quarto does not emit the level-3 `sec-<param>` section ids in EPUB output, so these targets do not exist there and would fail epubcheck RSC-012. Cross-chapter anchors whose targets DO exist are repaired by `scripts/validate-epub.py`.)

- Link to ADAPTABLE cost parameter: [ADAPTABLE Trial Cost per Patient](#sec-adaptable_trial_cost_per_patient)
- Link to military spending parameter: [Global Military Spending](#sec-global_military_spending_annual_2024)
- Link to treaty reduction parameter: [Treaty Reduction Percentage](#sec-treaty_reduction_pct)
- Link to calculated parameter: [Treaty Annual Funding (calculated)](#sec-treaty_annual_funding)
- Link to appendix overview: [Parameters Overview](#sec-parameters-and-calculations)

If these work in PDF, we could potentially make variable values themselves link to their calculation sections.

:::
